scope: Credible conditions that would invalidate a major claim or architecture selection of Phase 2.

status_vocabulary.ELIMINATED: the condition cannot obtain given the design; an argument is given
status_vocabulary.BOUNDED: the condition can obtain but its consequences are contained by a named mechanism and a named residual
status_vocabulary.OPEN: the condition can obtain and is not contained; the architecture states the exposure

post_audit_additions: First round: DF-036..DF-040 (eliminated class), DF-041 (HF-005), DF-042 (HF-006).
Second round: DF-002 BOUNDED -> ELIMINATED (HF-022); DF-026 OPEN -> BOUNDED (HF-001 remedied by I-41/I-42); DF-043..DF-047 added.
note: Every defeater names what would confirm it, so that Phase-3 adversarial judging can attempt confirmation rather than argue about plausibility. ELIMINATED means the condition is unexpressible in the design, with the argument given and its own residual stated; it never means 'considered unlikely'.
totals_note: Totals are NOT restated here. They are derived mechanically from this file by the sealing script and recorded only in PHASE-2-MANIFEST.json and PHASE-2-SEAL.json. Second-round audit finding HF-023: a hand-maintained totals block inside the file it counts is a duplicate of a truth whose authority lives in the records themselves - precisely the duplicate-truth defect axiom A8 forbids, applied to this study's own deliverables. The architecture's rule is applied to the architecture's own documents.

target: D01 selection: chartered offices with exclusive typed powers
statement: The office structure may be institutional theatre: if in practice one implementation team writes all offices, the separation is nominal and every office effectively holds every power.
credibility: medium — this is the standard failure mode of layered permission designs.
bounding_mechanism: Exclusivity is checked mechanically (Alloy PO-009, DEFCHARTER compile-time assertions) and violation is void at admission rather than a review finding; the check is on the running charter, not on team structure.
residual: Mechanical exclusivity does not prevent an office from being designed to rubber-stamp. Nothing in the architecture forces an office to exercise judgement.
what_would_confirm: An audit showing that some office's admission predicate is trivially true for all inputs it receives.
consequence_if_confirmed: That office's power should be merged into its caller, or given a substantive admission predicate; the charter is amended.

target: D02/D22: where the warrant guarantee lives
statement: A custom method combination polices only generic-function calls, so an institutional effect reached by an ordinary in-office function call bypasses call-site warrant checking; and the package facility does not prevent an office reaching another office's internal symbols.
credibility: high - this was a true statement about the mechanism, and the first version wrongly accepted it as merely BOUNDED.
residual: Elimination is of the BYPASS. Admission is still only as good as the Charter it reconstructs from and the decoders it reads entries with, both of which are shared with K_v and are covered by DF-043. Unwarranted in-memory mutation of a derived store remains possible and is caught by the next rebuild-and-compare (I-31) rather than prevented; the method combination and the MOP guard are retained as defence in depth for early, well-diagnosed failure.
what_would_confirm: A committed entry whose (office, kind, fact-class) lies outside the Charter power table, or a warrant accepted that is not Charter-derived and digest-bound.
consequence_if_confirmed: PO-046 is false and the central authority guarantee fails; D02 must be re-opened.
elimination_argument: Enforcement was moved off the call site entirely (second audit round, HF-022, decision D02-e via challenge DC-02-4). Admission is now a pure, total, ACL2-admitted function admit-p(charter, entry) evaluated at the single append point by the verification kernel V_w, which imports no office package. It does not check a caller-supplied warrant; it reconstructs from the Charter whether office(entry) holds issue(kind, fact-class), and requires the presented warrant to be a Charter-derived capability bound to the entry content digest. PO-046 quantifies over ENTRIES, not over call paths: for all e, committed(e) implies charter-permits(office(e), kind(e), fact-class(e)). A bypassing call path therefore cannot produce a committed entry, whatever it does in memory.
revision_note: Status changed from BOUNDED to ELIMINATED in the second audit round. The first version accepted a bypassable enforcement mechanism as adequate; the creator directed that it be fixed rather than bounded.

target: D03: Registry-assigned norm identity
statement: Norm identity assigned by the Watchtower is a Watchtower opinion. If it systematically diverges from the identity practice of Greek legal professionals, every answer is technically correct and practically unusable.
credibility: medium-high — identity conventions in Greek legal practice are usage-driven and not fully codified.
bounding_mechanism: Identity assignments are defeasible, carry reopening predicates (I-10), and bind external identifiers (ELI/ECLI) as recorded assertions so that professional identity practice can be tracked as it emerges (RL-055).
residual: Divergence is only detectable by comparison against professional usage, which the architecture does not observe.
what_would_confirm: A sample of professional citations that fail to resolve against Registry identities.
consequence_if_confirmed: Add an identity-usage observation channel and treat professional citation practice as a source with its own authority semantics.

target: D04: authority as a derived relation over organ, instrument type, order and time
statement: The organ-to-authority mapping for the Greek legal order must be curated by hand. A curation error is a legal error that the kernel cannot detect, because the kernel computes correctly from a wrong table.
credibility: high — curation error is certain over a large corpus.
bounding_mechanism: The mapping is data, versioned, inspectable, and attackable in a docket; changing it triggers the regression obligation I-32; Rapporteur review applies to high-consequence authority classes.
residual: An error that is never challenged persists indefinitely; there is no internal signal that a mapping entry is wrong.
what_would_confirm: An admitted authority proposition contradicted by a competent legal source.
consequence_if_confirmed: Mapping amendment plus reopening of every decision whose reopening predicate references the amended entry.

target: D05: nine temporal axes
statement: Nine axes are argued sufficient for the Greek order but not proved sufficient. A tenth legally distinct axis (for example suspension of effect, anastoli, treated as genuinely distinct from cessation) may be required.
credibility: medium — the design already carries SUSPENDED as an instrument state, but not as an independent axis.
bounding_mechanism: Axes are propositions, not columns, so adding one is a kernel change under the regression obligation rather than a schema migration.
residual: Until an omission is noticed, propositions about the omitted phenomenon are silently approximated by the nearest axis.
what_would_confirm: A Greek legal phenomenon whose temporal behaviour cannot be expressed by the nine axes plus the cessation trichotomy without loss.
consequence_if_confirmed: Extend the axis set; re-derive; adjudicate divergences.

target: D06: native lineage with PROV and in-toto export
statement: Export fidelity is claimed only for the subset the target vocabularies can express. A consumer relying on the PROV export will read a graph that omits evidentiary degradation and may treat a derived text as equivalent to its source.
credibility: high — PROV's derivation relation is untyped as to fidelity (RL-059).
bounding_mechanism: Degradation is exported as custom qualified properties; the consolidation class and evidentiary status appear in every emitted citation (I-14, R-10) so the primary answer channel is unaffected.
residual: A third party consuming raw PROV and ignoring the custom properties reads a weaker but not false graph.
what_would_confirm: A downstream system asserting equivalence between an artifact and its derivation on the basis of the export.
consequence_if_confirmed: Refuse plain PROV export, or emit only PROV with a mandatory profile declaration.

target: A10 entrenchment; D11 record integrity
statement: Entrenchment binds institutional acts, not operators. An operator with filesystem write access can rewrite the record, remove entrenched axioms, and re-derive a consistent-looking state.
credibility: high — this is certain, not speculative.
bounding_mechanism: Converted from prevention to detection: Merkle consistency proofs against witnessed heads, independent witness co-signature, qualified electronic time stamps under Regulation (EU) 910/2014 (RL-011, RL-028), and the deletability experiment for derived stores.
residual: Detection depends on witnesses existing and being independent. An operator who also controls the witnesses defeats it. The architecture cannot close this and does not claim to.
what_would_confirm: Trivially confirmable in any deployment without independent witnesses.
consequence_if_confirmed: Integrity guarantees reduce to 'trust the operator'; the institution must publish that fact with every answer.

target: D07: five-rank evidentiary lattice
statement: Five ranks plus two special elements may be too coarse. In particular, a re-observation from a genuinely independent channel confirming the same digest is stronger than a single AUTHENTIC-UNSIGNED observation, and the lattice cannot express it.
credibility: medium
bounding_mechanism: Corroboration is represented as an additional argument supporting the same conclusion, not as a change to the artifact's status. PO-004 is proved over the order, not over its cardinality, so extending the chain does not invalidate the theorem.
residual: Corroboration strength is visible in the argument structure but not in the artifact's status, which some consumers will read alone.
what_would_confirm: A publication decision that would differ if corroboration raised artifact status.
consequence_if_confirmed: Add a rank; re-prove PO-004 at the new cardinality (mechanical).

target: D10: record plus artifacts as the only authorities
statement: Cold-start rebuild time grows without bound as the record grows. If a full rebuild becomes infeasible, checkpoints become load-bearing, and a checkpoint that cannot be rebuilt is a third authority.
credibility: medium-high over a multi-decade horizon.
bounding_mechanism: Checkpoints are verified by periodic rebuild-and-compare (SA-7); a checkpoint that fails to reproduce is discarded rather than trusted.
residual: If rebuild becomes infeasible, the verification also becomes infeasible, and the bound silently stops binding. This is the failure mode to watch.
what_would_confirm: Measured full-rebuild time exceeding the interval at which SA-7 can be scheduled.
consequence_if_confirmed: Introduce record compaction with adjudicated semantics, or accept checkpoints as authorities and say so explicitly in the charter.

target: D12: hybrid logical clocks
statement: HLC bounds divergence by the clock-synchronisation uncertainty epsilon, which is an operational property. If epsilon is violated for a sustained period, physical timestamps on entries are wrong while causality remains correct, and legal deadline computations derived from them are wrong.
credibility: medium
bounding_mechanism: Fault F7 marks entries CLOCK-ANOMALOUS; temporal propositions derived from anomalous stamps are recomputed once an anchored time is available (qualified time stamp on the record head).
residual: Deadline computations published during the anomaly and before recomputation may be wrong.
what_would_confirm: A published answer whose deadline arithmetic used a CLOCK-ANOMALOUS stamp.
consequence_if_confirmed: Suppress deadline-dependent answers whenever any supporting entry is CLOCK-ANOMALOUS.

target: D20/D21: ACL2-verified kernel executed under SBCL
statement: ACL2 verifies an applicative subset under its own logic and guard discipline. Execution under SBCL relies on a correspondence between that logic and the host implementation which is argued, not proved. A divergence — in arithmetic, in guard violation behaviour, in evaluation order, or in a compiler transformation — would mean the proved text and the executed text behave differently.
credibility: medium — the correspondence is well-established in industrial practice (RL-014) but is not a theorem.
bounding_mechanism: Guard verification; differential execution of kernel functions under the ACL2 evaluator and under SBCL over the regression corpus, with divergence treated as fault F9.
residual: Differential execution samples inputs; it does not prove equivalence. This is the single largest unproved dependency of the design and is carried into the seal's unresolved obligations.
what_would_confirm: Any input on which the two evaluators disagree.
consequence_if_confirmed: The kernel's proof value degrades to 'verified model of the kernel'; the architecture would then be no better than D20-d on O9, and D20 must be re-opened.

target: D20: TLA+ protocol obligations
statement: A TLA+ specification is a model of the shell, not the shell. Its correspondence to the running code is an argued refinement with no compilation or extraction step.
credibility: high — true of every TLA+ use.
bounding_mechanism: Deterministic simulation exercises the actual shell under the same fault classes the model checks, so a refinement error tends to surface as a simulation failure rather than remaining invisible.
residual: A refinement error that also escapes simulation is undetected.
what_would_confirm: A simulation trace violating a property the TLA+ model proves.
consequence_if_confirmed: Either the model or the code is wrong; the discrepancy is itself the finding.

target: D20: charter obligations discharged in Alloy 6
statement: Alloy analysis is bounded by scope. Power-exclusivity and lifecycle properties verified within a scope are not proved for all sizes, and the charter grows as offices and fact classes are added.
credibility: medium-high
bounding_mechanism: The charter is finite and small by design; scope is set to exceed the actual number of offices, powers and fact classes by a stated margin, and the margin is re-checked on every amendment.
residual: Scope adequacy is argued from the charter's finiteness, not proved; a property that only fails at larger scopes would be missed.
what_would_confirm: A counterexample found only above the analysed scope.
consequence_if_confirmed: Re-analyse at a larger scope or discharge the property by hand proof.

target: A3 kernel totality; D08 label computation
statement: Assumption-based label computation is worst-case exponential (RL-009). If the bound B_label is exhausted routinely rather than exceptionally, LABEL-INCOMPLETE becomes the normal state and the institution is mostly unable to publish.
credibility: medium — depends entirely on assumption-graph structure in practice.
bounding_mechanism: The assumption vocabulary is closed and small (the classes enumerated in R-07); assumptions attach to evidentiary and interpretive-choice points only, not to every fact; focused label computation is scoped to the docket's question.
residual: No bound is proved on assumption-graph width for real Greek legal corpora. Bound-exhaustion frequency is a self-model proposition, which means the institution will know, but knowing is not solving.
what_would_confirm: Measured LABEL-INCOMPLETE rate above a small fraction of dockets.
consequence_if_confirmed: Restrict assumption scope further, or accept a weaker but complete approximation with a declared status; D08 re-opens.

target: D08: grounded semantics as the admitted default
statement: Grounded semantics is sceptical: it may leave conclusions undecided that a legal reasoner would resolve. Restricting the default to grounded may make the institution unable to answer questions it should answer.
credibility: medium-high — this is a known property of grounded semantics, not a speculation.
bounding_mechanism: Bounded preferred-semantics search is available with SEMANTICS-INCOMPLETE status; the declared preference ordering resolves most legal conflicts before semantics selection matters.
residual: Questions requiring credulous acceptance under preferred semantics may be answerable only with an incompleteness marker.
what_would_confirm: A class of legal questions routinely returning UNDECIDED under grounded but resolvable under preferred.
consequence_if_confirmed: Admit preferred semantics for that class with an explicit computational bound and status.

target: D09/I-19: lex superior > lex specialis > lex posterior as the default ordering
statement: That this ordering is correct for the Greek legal order is a normative-legal claim, not a formal one. It may be wrong in general, or wrong for specific instrument-type pairs, and the architecture would then systematically resolve conflicts incorrectly.
credibility: high — the claim is legal, and legal claims about meta-norm priority are contested.
bounding_mechanism: The ordering is data: explicit, inspectable, attackable in a docket, versioned, and changing it triggers the regression obligation. The architecture does not settle the question; it makes the answer visible and revisable.
residual: Until challenged, the default governs every conflict resolution. The architecture's contribution is transparency, not correctness.
what_would_confirm: A Greek legal authority applying a different priority in a class of cases.
consequence_if_confirmed: Amend the ordering; reopen every decision whose reopening predicate references it (predicate Xi-4 exists for exactly this).

target: D13: single-threaded regions
statement: Serialising each office may make the Tribunal a throughput bottleneck under heavy adjudication load, since dockets are the only path to admitted belief.
credibility: medium
bounding_mechanism: Argument construction and label computation are pure and run in parallel over immutable snapshots; only the admission act itself is serialised, and admission is cheap relative to derivation.
residual: If admission itself becomes the bottleneck, the region model must be sharded by norm-identity partition, which introduces a cross-partition consistency question the design does not currently answer.
what_would_confirm: Measured admission queue growth under realistic docket volume.
consequence_if_confirmed: Shard the Tribunal by partition with a stated cross-partition protocol; D13 re-opens.

target: R-07: closed assumption vocabulary
statement: The assumption classes of R-07 are argued closed by construction over the entry kinds, but the argument is informal. A missing class would mean some beliefs rest on undeclared assumptions, so defeat would not propagate to them.
credibility: medium
bounding_mechanism: Adding a class is a charter amendment, so the vocabulary cannot drift silently. Every leaf of every argument must be either EVIDENCE-backed or a declared assumption (I-15), so an undeclared assumption cannot appear as a leaf without failing admission.
residual: An assumption smuggled into a *rule* rather than a leaf would escape. Rules are curated data, so this is a curation risk.
what_would_confirm: A defeasible rule whose applicability depends on an unstated condition.
consequence_if_confirmed: Extract the condition as a declared assumption class; re-derive.

target: I-32: regression obligation on kernel promotion
statement: The obligation is only as strong as the regression corpus. A kernel change that is correct on the corpus and wrong off it is promoted without objection.
credibility: high — certain for any finite corpus.
bounding_mechanism: The corpus is curated high-consequence decisions plus a random sample; corpus composition is itself a self-model proposition subject to A6, so its adequacy is a falsifiable claim rather than an assumption.
residual: Coverage of the decision space is not measured, only sampled.
what_would_confirm: A post-promotion divergence on a decision outside the corpus.
consequence_if_confirmed: Expand the corpus along the dimension that diverged; the divergence itself becomes a corpus member.

target: D15: enumeration-closure gap detection
statement: Enumeration-closure detection depends on the Government Gazette continuing to number issues sequentially within series and year, and on that numbering being observable. If the source changes its enumeration practice, the primary blind-spot detector fails.
credibility: medium — publication practice is stable but not guaranteed.
bounding_mechanism: Three independent detectors (enumeration, reference closure, cadence) plus vitality probes; loss of one degrades detection to INDETERMINATE-COVERAGE rather than to false COVERED.
residual: Detection power genuinely decreases; the architecture guarantees honesty about the decrease, not preservation of the capability.
what_would_confirm: An observed change in Gazette enumeration practice.
consequence_if_confirmed: Re-model the source; coverage for the affected windows becomes INDETERMINATE until a new signal is identified.

target: OA-4: the Greek legal corpus is small enough for in-memory derived state
statement: If the structured legal state does not fit in memory on a commodity machine, or the artifact corpus growth outpaces storage planning, the derived-state model and the nine-axis adjudicated temporal model become operationally infeasible.
credibility: medium — the assumption is plausible but unmeasured in this phase.
bounding_mechanism: None yet. The assumption is declared, not discharged.
residual: Two consequential decisions (D05, D10) rest on it.
what_would_confirm: Measurement of the Greek structured legal state exceeding the declared memory budget.
consequence_if_confirmed: D05 and D10 must be re-opened; partitioned derivation with an explicit cross-partition consistency protocol would be required.

target: D14: deterministic scheduler
statement: Determinism holds only for effects routed through the injected environment object. A single un-shimmed effect — an ambient clock read, a hash-table iteration order dependency, a library call performing I/O — breaks replay silently.
credibility: high — this is the known failure mode of the technique (RL-017, RL-057).
bounding_mechanism: Build-time audit of the shell's imports; a replay-divergence detector comparing derived state on replay against the recorded state; the kernel is effect-free by ACL2 admissibility so the exposure is confined to the shell.
residual: An effect that is deterministic in practice but not routed through the environment will pass the divergence detector until the day it does not.
what_would_confirm: Any replay divergence.
consequence_if_confirmed: Locate and shim the effect; treat the interval as REPLAY-UNVERIFIED.

target: D15/D16: coverage for sources without structural signal; sampling latency
statement: For sources with no enumeration and no reliable cadence — Greek court publication practice is a real instance (RL-052) — coverage is permanently INDETERMINATE and the institution can never claim completeness about jurisprudence. Separately, salience-weighted sampling means some source mutations are detected late.
credibility: high — both are consequences of the design as stated.
bounding_mechanism: Reference closure partially compensates: decisions cited by acquired material become acquisition obligations. Detection latency is published as a self-model proposition.
residual: Jurisprudence coverage claims are structurally unavailable. This is a limit of the world reflected honestly, but it is a limit.
what_would_confirm: Immediately confirmable: the architecture states it.
consequence_if_confirmed: Accepted. The institution reports INDETERMINATE rather than a false completeness figure.

target: Research ledger precision
statement: Several ledger entries carry verification residuals: the Jones and Sergot 1996 volume number is inconsistently reported across secondary sources (RL-010); the Greek Constitution was consulted in its 2008 revision text although a 2019 revision exists (RL-021); Law 3469/2006 and Law 4622/2019 were consulted in commercially codified form (RL-024, RL-027); the ELI ontology version and the EUR-Lex ELI register page could not be read (RL-005, RL-060); Greek ELI implementation status was not verified against a live endpoint (RL-055); the eIDAS consolidated text after Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 was not re-verified (RL-028).
credibility: high — these are stated facts about this phase's verification, not risks.
bounding_mechanism: Each affected ledger entry names its limitation; no architectural decision rests solely on an unverified entry. The legally operative claims (L1, L2, L4, L5, L6) each have at least one entry verified by direct fetch in this phase.
residual: Citation precision is below archival standard for six entries.
what_would_confirm: Direct verification against the official consolidated texts.
consequence_if_confirmed: Ledger correction; no architectural consequence expected, but Article 42 and Article 26 stability across the 2019 revision must be confirmed before operational reliance.

target: D17: quarantine as derived status
statement: Quarantine exit is a legal judgement. A wrongly released item cannot be detected by the kernel, only by a later adjudication, and in the interim it can support published answers.
credibility: medium-high
bounding_mechanism: Release carries a reopening predicate; released items supporting published answers are in the full-verification tier of the anti-entropy schedule (D16).
residual: The interval between wrong release and later adjudication is unbounded.
what_would_confirm: A released item later repudiated after supporting a publication.
consequence_if_confirmed: Correction obligation for the affected answers; tighten release criteria for the item class.

target: D18/A6: metacognitive causality
statement: Before the two-kernel remedy, self-model propositions and the falsifiers that audit them were computed by one and the same derivation kernel, so a kernel defect could corrupt both the world model and its audit together - condition WC-7. This is the condition the remedy addresses.
credibility: high as a description of the pre-remedy design; the condition no longer obtains for the publication-critical subset.
bounding_mechanism: Structurally remedied in the second audit round on the creator ruling that HF-001 is a defect, not an inherent limit. There are now two kernels (I-41): V_w is independently authored from the same written specification by a different author using a different algorithmic approach, separately ACL2-admitted, and shares no code with K_v (I-42, build-time import-closure audit PO-042) beyond ANSI CL and a frozen separately-verified decoder library. V_w reads R and A|_R directly and never reads K_v output; coverage falsifiers are recomputed from raw observation entries including vitality-probe results. The Inspectorate uses V_w and only V_w (SA-14). Disagreement is fault F15, which suspends the publication power. A K_v defect alone therefore produces a detected disagreement rather than a confident wrong answer.
residual: Scope and common mode. (i) V_w covers the publication-critical subset - admission, the invariants that gate speech, and the falsifiers - not the whole state; a K_v defect outside that subset is still undetected by this mechanism, though it remains subject to F9 detection. (ii) Common-mode failure is not addressed at all and is carried separately as DF-043.
what_would_confirm: A K_v defect within the publication-critical subset that does not produce K_v/V_w disagreement.
consequence_if_confirmed: The independence of the two implementations is not real - most likely because they were derived from one another rather than independently - and I-41 must be re-established with genuinely independent authorship.
revision_note: Status changed from OPEN to BOUNDED in the second audit round. The residual it now names (scope plus common mode) is materially smaller and different in kind from the self-reference defect it originally named.
status_note: BOUNDED, not OPEN. The Inspectorate's verdicts and every self-model falsifier outcome are computed by V_w (I-41), which shares no code with the derivation kernel (I-42, PO-042) and never reads its output. Any artifact describing same-kernel auditing as current, or DF-026 as open, is stale.

target: D18: self-model in the shared epistemic store
statement: Sharing the store means a flood of self-model propositions could crowd out or slow world derivation, or that a defeat cascade in self-model space could destabilise legal conclusions that merely mention coverage.
credibility: low-medium
bounding_mechanism: Self-model propositions enter legal arguments only through the SELF-MODEL defeater class, which attacks publication eligibility rather than legal content; coverage claims never appear as premises of authority propositions.
residual: The separation is by rule, not by type; a rule permitting a coverage claim as a legal premise would break it.
what_would_confirm: An admitted authority argument with a coverage proposition as a leaf.
consequence_if_confirmed: Add a type-level prohibition analogous to I-20's doctrine exclusion.

target: I-26: executable reopening predicates
statement: Reopening predicates are drawn from a closed, decidable language. A condition inexpressible in that language cannot trigger automatic reopening, so some decisions will silently outlive their justification.
credibility: medium-high
bounding_mechanism: The language covers the observed classes of legal change (evidentiary degradation, modification relations, coverage transitions, preference amendment, kernel promotion); the Rapporteur holds standing power to reopen any docket manually; extending the language is a charter amendment.
residual: Adequacy is argued from observed change classes, not proved.
what_would_confirm: A decision that should have reopened and did not, discovered by human review.
consequence_if_confirmed: Extend the predicate language; re-evaluate all live predicates under the extension.

target: D23: macro-generated proof obligations
statement: The macro expanders that generate proof-obligation stubs and runtime invariant checks are part of the trusted computing base and are not themselves verified. A defective expander could emit an obligation that is trivially true, or omit one.
credibility: medium
bounding_mechanism: The invariant register is machine-readable and independently enumerable; the Inspectorate cross-checks that every invariant in PHASE-2-REQUIREMENTS-AND-INVARIANTS.md has a corresponding live obligation with a non-trivial statement.
residual: The cross-check is itself code in the same trusted base.
what_would_confirm: An obligation that passes vacuously.
consequence_if_confirmed: Hand-write the affected obligations; reduce expander scope.

target: D24: restart selection as a warranted act
statement: Recording every restart selection as an institutional act may flood the record with operational noise, degrading the signal-to-noise ratio of the institutional memory and increasing rebuild cost.
credibility: medium
bounding_mechanism: Only restarts classified as institutionally significant are recorded as acts; purely operational retries are environment-trace entries, replayable but not institutional.
residual: The classification of which restarts are institutionally significant is a policy judgement that could be drawn wrongly in either direction.
what_would_confirm: Record growth dominated by restart records, or an institutionally consequential remedy that left no act record.
consequence_if_confirmed: Re-draw the classification boundary; the boundary is charter data, so this is an amendment.

target: I-37/D26: round-trip verified surface rendering
statement: The round-trip check verifies that the rendered text's claim-slot set matches the admitted proposition set. It does not verify rhetorical implicature: a rendering can be technically faithful and still mislead by emphasis, ordering, or omission of a qualification that is present but de-emphasised.
credibility: high
bounding_mechanism: High-consequence proposition classes are restricted to templated renderings with no model involvement; all qualifications are structurally required fields of the answer, not prose.
residual: For non-templated classes, misleading emphasis is possible and undetected.
what_would_confirm: A rendered answer whose claim set is correct but whose reading by a competent jurist differs materially from the admitted propositions.
consequence_if_confirmed: Extend templating to the affected class.

target: D21/Lisp design: choice of Common Lisp
statement: A language with closed algebraic data types and exhaustive pattern matching would give a stronger static guarantee on the eight-kind separation than CLOS class hierarchies do, since CLOS cannot check exhaustiveness of a method set over an open class graph.
credibility: high — this is conceded in PHASE-2-LISP-NATIVE-DESIGN.md section 13.
bounding_mechanism: The trade is stated rather than hidden: the absence of an extraction seam and a re-implementation seam (Lisp design section 1) and warrant checking at the append point are judged to dominate under O9. NOTE (R5 finding 7): an earlier wording asserted claim WC-2, withdrawn.
residual: Kind separation rests on discipline plus a build-time audit rather than on exhaustiveness checking.
what_would_confirm: A kind-coercion defect that a sum-type language would have rejected at compile time.
consequence_if_confirmed: Add a build-time exhaustiveness audit over the kind class graph; if defects persist, D21 must be re-opened against a hybrid (verified kernel in ACL2, shell in a sum-type language) with the cross-language boundary cost stated.

target: The architecture as a whole
statement: The institutional apparatus — offices, warrants, dockets, entrenchment, suspension — may be disproportionate to the mandate. If the Watchtower's actual questions are answerable by a well-provenanced bitemporal corpus, the apparatus adds failure modes without adding answers.
credibility: medium — this is the strongest available attack on the whole design and must be stated as such.
bounding_mechanism: Partially answered by the gate analysis: candidate A1 fails G1 and G2 not for lack of features but structurally, and the failures are concrete (evidence laundering, no defeasibility, coverage claims that cannot be honest). But 'structurally inadequate' is not the same as 'this apparatus is the right size'.
residual: No evidence in this phase establishes that the full apparatus is necessary rather than merely sufficient. Necessity would require showing, for each office and each invariant, a concrete question that becomes unanswerable without it.
what_would_confirm: A demonstration that a materially simpler design satisfies G1, G2 and Tier 1 objectives.
consequence_if_confirmed: The architecture is dominated and must be replaced. This is the intended target of Phase-3 adversarial judging.

target: D19: the Rapporteur human office
statement: Mandatory human review for high-consequence classes creates a dependency on human availability. If the Rapporteur is unavailable, high-consequence propositions cannot be admitted and the institution's coverage of exactly the most important material degrades first.
credibility: high
bounding_mechanism: Unreviewed high-consequence propositions are held as SUPPORTED but publication-ineligible rather than rejected, so evidence accumulates and no work is lost; the backlog is a self-model proposition with the A6 triple, so the institution reports its own review debt.
residual: Availability is outside the architecture's control, and the degradation is concentrated where it matters most.
what_would_confirm: A sustained review backlog on high-consequence classes.
consequence_if_confirmed: Either broaden the office, or narrow the high-consequence class definition — both charter amendments, both visible.

target: A9: machine-learned containment
statement: Confining models to proposal and rendering may materially reduce reachable coverage of unstructured Greek legal prose — doctrine, commentary, older scanned material, court reasoning — where deterministic parsing is infeasible and a model is the only viable reader.
credibility: medium-high
bounding_mechanism: Proposals are unlimited in volume and cost nothing when wrong; the constraint is only that a proposal must pass a deterministic verifier before an office acts. Where no verifier exists, the material is held at DOCTRINAL or SECONDARY status and remains usable as an argument source, not as authority.
residual: Material for which no verifier and no authoritative channel exists is effectively outside the institution's propositional reach, however much a model could say about it.
what_would_confirm: A class of legally significant material with no verifiable acquisition path.
consequence_if_confirmed: Accepted as a coverage limit and published as such, rather than relaxing A9. The evidence for A9 (RL-030) is stronger than the cost of the limit.

target: A4/I-04: monotone evidentiary degradation
statement: Evidence laundering: repeated derivation (extract, clean, normalise, re-serialise) causes a derived text to acquire the apparent evidentiary standing of its authentic source.
credibility: high as a failure mode of legal-informatics systems generally; this is the defect A4 exists to prevent.
elimination_argument: Transformations form a closed algebra of constructors, and no constructor has a rank-raising effect. Laundering is therefore not forbidden by policy but unexpressible: there is no term in the algebra that produces it. PO-004 states the property over the closed constructor set and is discharged in ACL2, where the kernel text proved is the kernel text executed (RL-014). Raising strength requires a new ACQUISITION plus an Authentication act (I-05), which is new evidence, not derivation.
residual: Elimination holds within the algebra. Adding a constructor without re-discharging PO-004 would reopen it; the DEFINVARIANT macro ties the obligation to the definition (Lisp design section 7.3), and DF-029 covers the expander's own trustworthiness.
what_would_confirm: A transformation constructor admitted into the algebra with a rank-raising effect, or a proof failure of PO-004 at an extended cardinality.
consequence_if_confirmed: A4 fails and the entire evidentiary discipline reduces to convention; D06 and D07 must be re-opened.

target: C3/A1/SA-9: adapters and models confer no authority
statement: A source adapter, normaliser, loader, or model component produces an entry that functions as an authority claim, either directly or by being the only support for one.
credibility: high as a general failure mode; every disqualified candidate architecture exhibits it.
elimination_argument: Two independent structural barriers. First, the warrant of an adapter or model principal grants only issue(OBSERVATION) - narrowed in the second audit round when PROPOSAL ceased to be an entry kind (I-03, I-45) - so any other entry from such a principal is void at ADMISSION, which is the append point and is not reachable by an in-office function call, so the DF-002 bypass does not apply here. Second, the authority derivation function's domain type does not accept a channel or adapter identifier (I-02), so an authority conclusion cannot be justified by the fact of retrieval even if an entry existed. And proposals are no longer entries at all: they live in a spool that is not an argument of the kernel (I-45), so a proposal cannot be a premise because the derivation cannot see it - a property of the kernel signature rather than a rule about the support relation.
residual: Elimination is of the structural path. A human office could still admit an authority proposition whose only real basis was a proposal it believed; that is a Tribunal judgement error covered by DF-004, not an adapter conferring authority.
what_would_confirm: A committed AUTHORITY entry whose warrant traces to an adapter or model principal, or an authority argument with a PROPOSAL leaf.
consequence_if_confirmed: C3 is violated at the architectural level; the design fails its primary acceptance condition.
revision_note: Strengthened in the second audit round: the second barrier moved from a rule about the support relation to a property of the kernel signature (HF-021), and the admission barrier moved from a trusted warrant to a reconstructed one (HF-022).

target: I-20: doctrine cannot ground authority
statement: A doctrinal position (commentary, treatise, scholarly opinion) becomes a load-bearing premise of an authority proposition, so that the institution asserts what the law is on the strength of what a commentator said it is.
credibility: high as a failure mode; it is the standard way legal knowledge bases blur authority.
elimination_argument: DOCTRINAL is incomparable in the evidentiary lattice rather than merely low, so no accumulation of doctrine reaches the authentic chain (D07, iteration 3). The kernel predicate for admitting an AUTHORITY proposition rejects any argument with a DOCTRINAL leaf; this is a decidable property of the argument tree and is discharged by PO-020 in ACL2. The Doctrine Office holds no issue power over AUTHORITY (SA-1), so the same content cannot enter by a different route.
residual: Doctrine legitimately supplies interpretive rules offered to the Tribunal. If a doctrinal position were encoded as a defeasible rule rather than as a leaf, it would influence conclusions without appearing as a DOCTRINAL leaf; that path is covered by DF-018 (assumptions and conditions smuggled into rules) and by rule curation being versioned and inspectable.
what_would_confirm: An admitted AUTHORITY argument whose leaf set contains a DOCTRINAL entry, or a defeasible rule whose only justification is a doctrinal source and which is treated as strict.
consequence_if_confirmed: L8 is violated; the institution is conflating doctrine with authority, which is a primary disqualifier.

target: C7/I-18: no silent degradation under resource pressure
statement: When label computation exceeds its bound, the system truncates the label and answers anyway, so a belief with incomplete support is published as though fully supported.
credibility: high as a failure mode of any bounded reasoner; it is the specific behaviour C7 forbids.
elimination_argument: The kernel's label computation is total and returns a status value; there is no code path that discards environments and returns a bare label. Because the kernel is applicative and ACL2-admitted, the return type is inspectable and the status cannot be dropped without a type error at the call site. LABEL-INCOMPLETE is structurally ineligible to support a publication (I-35 combined with the publication ADMISSION gate), so even an office that ignored the condition could not publish on it.
residual: Elimination concerns silence, not frequency. A high rate of LABEL-INCOMPLETE would make the institution largely unable to publish; that consequence is DF-014, which is BOUNDED and unresolved.
what_would_confirm: A published answer whose support includes a belief whose label computation hit the bound.
consequence_if_confirmed: C7 is violated; the architecture would be presenting bounded computation as complete reasoning.

target: A2/A3: backfill and correction cannot corrupt history
statement: Inserting historical material after the fact, or applying a source correction, rewrites or invalidates previously derived state in a way that cannot be explained or reproduced.
credibility: high as a failure mode; it is the known open wound of both the ETL tradition and the event-sourcing tradition.
elimination_argument: Backfill is an append of OBSERVATION entries with an earlier t_observe and a later t_record; the nine-axis model separates these, so no reordering of the record is ever required, and no mutation path exists (the record has no update or delete operation, and the artifact store is write-once). Because state = K_v(R, A|_R) is pure, re-derivation after a backfill is total and deterministic; the difference between the pre-backfill and post-backfill derivations is computable and, where it changes an admitted decision, is materialised as a DIVERGENCE for adjudication. Correction is likewise an append, with the superseded artifact retained (I-13).
residual: Elimination is of corruption, not of workload: a large backfill can change many conclusions at once, and each changed admitted decision requires adjudication. Also bounded by DF-009 (rebuild cost) and by the sealed-void exception of F13, which is the only content-removing mechanism.
what_would_confirm: A backfill or correction that alters a previously derived conclusion without producing a DIVERGENCE record, or that renders a prior answer unexplainable.
consequence_if_confirmed: A2 or A3 fails; replay and institutional memory lose their meaning, and D10 and D16 must be re-opened.

target: I-14 / the WATCHTOWER-RECONSTRUCTION consolidation class
statement: A machine reconstruction of a consolidated text may be materially worse than a competent legal editor's consolidation, and consumers may not respect the class distinction in practice: a clearly labelled reconstruction that is nonetheless read as an official consolidated text does the same damage as an unlabelled one.
credibility: high — this is the practical form of hostile-audit finding HF-005, and label-ignoring is normal user behaviour.
bounding_mechanism: The class is structural, not advisory: a WATCHTOWER-RECONSTRUCTION is void at the publication boundary in answer to a request for an official codified text (I-14), and the class appears in every emitted citation. Reconstruction is additionally constrained by I-40 (amendment-chain confluence) so that it is at least order-independent and produces RECONSTRUCTION-AMBIGUOUS rather than an arbitrary result where modifications overlap without an admitted ordering. The Rapporteur office is where editorial judgement is located when the reconstruction is not good enough.
residual: Neither the structural class nor confluence makes a reconstruction as good as an editor's. Where official codification exists under Law 4622/2019 Arts. 65-66 (RL-027), the reconstruction should not be used at all; where it does not, the reconstruction is the only available answer and its quality is unverified.
what_would_confirm: A reconstruction that is confluent, correctly labelled, and still materially wrong as against an official consolidated text for the same date.
consequence_if_confirmed: Restrict reconstruction publication to cases with no official consolidated text, and route the rest to Rapporteur review; the high-consequence class definition is an Amendment Council provision, so this is a visible amendment.

target: A.2.1 genesis; A10 entrenchment
statement: Genesis locates the founding authority but cannot legitimate it. A Charter that entrenches a defective axiom is entrenched exactly as effectively as one that entrenches a sound axiom, and the institution has no internal means of recognising the difference — the Inspectorate audits conformity to the Charter, never the Charter's own soundness.
credibility: high — this is a structural property of entrenchment, conceded in the design.
bounding_mechanism: Partial only: the Charter text, its digest, the founding principals and a qualified electronic time stamp are all in entry e0 and are inspectable by any party holding the record and a witnessed head, so a defective founding is at least visible and attributable rather than tacit. The seven entrenched axioms are stated in full and each carries its own falsifier in PHASE-2-CREATOR-AXIOMS.md, so an external reviewer can attack them directly.
residual: No internal mechanism can revise an entrenched axiom that turns out to be wrong. The only remedy is a new genesis, which is a new institution and loses continuity of memory — precisely the thing the architecture exists to preserve.
what_would_confirm: An entrenched axiom shown to be wrong. The most exposed candidates are A6 (metacognitive adequacy: if the triple requirement excludes a needed class of self-knowledge, R-08's a/b split shows the strain already) and A9 (model containment: if DF-035's coverage cost proves severe).
consequence_if_confirmed: The institution must be re-founded, or the entrenchment set must have been narrower. Phase-3 judging should treat the entrenchment set itself as a decision to attack, not as a given.

target: I-41/I-42: the two-kernel remedy for HF-001
statement: Common-mode failure across K_v and V_w. The two kernels are independently authored but from the SAME written specification, run on the same SBCL, are checked by the same ACL2, and share the frozen decoder library that I-42 permits as the single deliberate intersection. A defect in the specification, the substrate, the prover, or the decoders defeats both simultaneously: they agree, no F15 fault fires, and the institution speaks with confidence.
credibility: high - this is the known and expected residual of any N-version scheme, and it is structurally present here.
bounding_mechanism: Partial only. Independent authorship from a written specification by a different author using a different algorithmic approach reduces correlated implementation error but does nothing about specification error. The decoder library is frozen and separately verified, which narrows that path without closing it. Differential execution under two evaluators (ACL2 and SBCL) probes the substrate path. The Rapporteur, a human office, is outside both kernels entirely and holds standing reopening power - this is the only mitigation that is genuinely outside the common mode.
residual: Specification defects are not addressed by any mechanism in the architecture. This is now the deepest residual in the design, replacing the self-reference defect that the creator ruled must be fixed.
what_would_confirm: A defect in a publication-critical property on which K_v and V_w agree and both are wrong. The most likely discovery route is external: a legal challenge to an emitted answer, or Rapporteur review.
consequence_if_confirmed: The two-kernel remedy is shown to bound implementation error but not specification error, which is what it claims. The consequence is not that I-41 fails but that the specification itself must acquire an independent check - the natural candidate being a formal statement of the publication-critical properties reviewed separately from both implementations.

target: I-43: R-boundedness of the artifact store
statement: Enforcing that the artifact store contains nothing the record names could discard genuine evidence, because bytes necessarily arrive before the ACQUISITION entry that names them can commit.
credibility: medium-high - the crash window is real, since bytes land before the ACQUISITION entry commits.
bounding_mechanism: Structurally resolved in the third audit round by the staged-admission protocol I-47 (HF-029). Bytes land in a staging area S that is neither R, A nor P and is invisible to both kernels; the ACQUISITION entry is appended FIRST; only then is the object atomically promoted into A by same-volume rename. The unavoidable crash window therefore leaves R naming a digest A lacks - a state I-44 already governs - rather than A holding bytes R does not name, which would be a bare I-43 violation. Promotion is idempotent and resumable at recovery. Staged orphans are re-offered to the acquisition plan and, if still unnamed after the declared retention window, garbage-collected WITH A RECORD, so a silently discarded fetch is impossible.
residual: The retention window and the sweep interval are unset policy parameters. A staged orphan whose source becomes permanently unavailable before promotion is lost, and the record shows only that it was collected, not what it contained.
what_would_confirm: A staged object that reached no terminal disposition, or an object present in A that no entry of R names.
consequence_if_confirmed: I-47 is violated; the promotion path has a route into A that bypasses the protocol, and I-43 is unenforceable on the write path.
revision_note: Third audit round: the crash window this defeater named is now closed by construction rather than merely bounded; the residual is narrowed to policy parameters and to permanent source loss.

target: D28/I-45: proposals in a deletable spool
statement: Proposal content is not recoverable from the record. A real entry may cite a proposal's digest as provenance, but the text of the proposal is deleted with the spool, so a later inquiry into why an office found a particular proposal persuasive has the fact and the identity but not the content.
credibility: high - this is a stated consequence of the design, not a risk.
bounding_mechanism: The digest citation preserves the fact that a proposal existed, its identity, and its binding to the entry that acted on it. More importantly, the design makes the question less consequential than it appears: an office acting on a proposal must derive the content itself from evidence and issue an entry whose support is that evidence, so the JUSTIFICATION of the entry is fully recorded and fully attackable. The proposal is the occasion, not the reason.
residual: A retrospective study of what the models proposed - as opposed to what the institution concluded - is not possible from the record alone. If model behaviour itself becomes a subject of inquiry, the record cannot answer it.
what_would_confirm: An inquiry that needs proposal content and cannot proceed without it.
consequence_if_confirmed: Operate a separate, explicitly non-institutional research log for model output, outside the record and outside the artifact store, with its own retention policy. This must not become a third store the kernel can see (I-45).

target: I-33 / Lisp design section 5.1: the MOP slot-access interception
statement: The AMOP slot-access protocol is honoured for instances of a custom metaclass, but this is an implementation-dependent property, not a language guarantee: implementations may optimise slot access, and low-level instance access bypasses the protocol entirely. The metaclass is therefore defence in depth and cannot carry an enforcement claim.
credibility: high - this is a correct statement about the metaobject protocol and about implementation practice.
bounding_mechanism: Three things. (i) The guarantee is pinned to SBCL and cited as such (RL-038, RL-039), not claimed as portable. (ii) A build-time audit asserts that no institutional class is reached through low-level instance access. (iii) Most importantly, following the second audit round the MOP guard is defence in depth, not the guarantee: authority enforcement lives at the append point in V_w (I-46), and unwarranted in-memory mutation of a DERIVED store is corrected by the next rebuild-and-compare (I-31), because a derived store that disagrees with K_v(R, A|_R) is unconstitutional by definition.
residual: An SBCL version change could alter slot-access optimisation behaviour. This is treated as a substrate change requiring the regression obligation I-32, in the same class as any other SBCL upgrade.
what_would_confirm: An institutional slot mutated without passing the metaclass guard.
consequence_if_confirmed: Detection latency for in-memory mutation increases to the rebuild-and-compare interval. The invariant itself is unaffected, which is the point of having moved enforcement.

target: The seal's own counts
statement: Counts reported in the manifest and the seal could be hand-entered while being asserted as mechanically derived. In the first sealing this was actually the case: invariant, proof-obligation, architecture, fault, assurance-claim and audit-finding counts were literals in the sealing script, yet the seal asserted counts_recomputed_mechanically_from_the_artifacts = true. The values happened to be correct, which is worse rather than better, since a hand-entered count that is right today drifts silently tomorrow.
credibility: high - confirmed by inspection of the first sealing script in the second audit round (HF-023).
bounding_mechanism: Every count is now extracted from the artifacts themselves by the sealing script: invariants and proof obligations from the requirements document, findings from the report, faults from the failure model, assurance claims from the assurance case, architectures from the candidates document, and decision/contender/challenge/defeater/source counts from the JSONL records. Any count that cannot be so derived is emitted with hand_asserted = true and is listed separately, so the distinction is visible in the seal rather than hidden by it. This is axiom A8 applied to this study's own deliverables: a count is a derived store, and a derived store that cannot be rebuilt from its source is a second authority.
residual: Extraction depends on the artifacts' formatting conventions - heading shapes and identifier patterns. A reformatting that changed those conventions would silently change a count, so the extraction is itself a dependency, merely a visible and re-runnable one rather than an invisible one.
what_would_confirm: A count in the seal that does not match a fresh extraction from the artifacts.
consequence_if_confirmed: Re-extract and re-seal. The check is cheap and repeatable, which is the property the first sealing lacked.

target: Lisp design section 1.0: the ACL2 surface-syntax shim
statement: ACL2 surface forms - xargs declarations, mbe, defthm and the like - are not ANSI Common Lisp. The kernel is written in the intersection dialect and a small frozen compatibility shim makes those forms inert under plain CL. That shim sits between what ACL2 admits and what the host compiles, and it is part of the trusted computing base while being itself unverified.
credibility: high - a structural property of using one text for two toolchains, and unstated before R3 because claims WC-1 and WC-2 concealed the question.
bounding_mechanism: The shim is small, frozen, and separately reviewed; it performs no computation, only makes ACL2-specific forms inert; and differential execution of kernel functions under the ACL2 evaluator and under SBCL over the regression corpus would surface a shim that changed behaviour rather than merely eliding a declaration.
residual: A shim defect that changes behaviour identically under both evaluators is undetectable by the differential. The shim is also common-mode across K_v and V_w, so it compounds DF-043.
what_would_confirm: A kernel function whose behaviour differs between ACL2-admitted execution and shimmed SBCL execution, traceable to the shim.
consequence_if_confirmed: The narrowing claim in Lisp design section 1.0 weakens: seam (2) becomes a live gap rather than a bounded one, and the comparative advantage over extraction-based platforms shrinks.

target: D22 / Lisp design section 6: what the package model actually secures
statement: After package locks are correctly reclassified as hygiene (HF-028), the package model's only load-bearing role is that kernel disjointness I-42 is decidable on the package graph. If that decision procedure is wrong - if the computed transitive closure omits a dependency reachable at runtime rather than at load time - then I-42 is not established and the I-41 remedy rests on an unverified claim of independence.
credibility: medium-high. Runtime-reachable dependencies that a static closure misses are a real phenomenon: symbols interned at runtime, code loaded by a later require, or a dependency reached through a dynamic variable rather than a package reference.
bounding_mechanism: Both kernels are ACL2-admitted and therefore cannot load code, intern at runtime, or reach a dependency through an effectful path - the same admissibility that establishes purity also makes the static closure faithful for the kernels specifically. The closure is computed over ASDF system definitions plus defpackage forms and is asserted to equal exactly {COMMON-LISP, watchtower/decoders} (PO-042).
residual: Faithfulness of the closure rests on ACL2 admissibility rather than on the package graph itself, so this defeater is downstream of DF-011: if admissibility does not entail what it is taken to entail on the host, the closure argument weakens with it.
what_would_confirm: A dependency reachable from V_w at runtime that does not appear in its computed load-time closure.
consequence_if_confirmed: I-42 is unestablished, I-41's independence claim becomes an assertion, and the HF-001 remedy is materially weakened.

target: I-27 / the institutional method combination: cleanup completion
statement: ANSI UNWIND-PROTECT guarantees ENTRY into the cleanup forms on normal or non-local exit from the protected form. It does not protect a cleanup form that itself performs a non-local exit. If one :record method signals or throws, later :record methods do not run, so the act may be only partially recorded.
credibility: high - this is a property of the standard, not a speculation. Raised by R5 finding 10.
bounding_mechanism: Partial only. The act-context bindings are established outside the UNWIND-PROTECT so that every cleanup form that DOES run sees valid outcome and warrant values (HF-027). That fixes what cleanup forms observe; it does not guarantee that all of them execute.
residual: No aggregate-cleanup protocol is specified. The design does not yet define a nested protocol that attempts every required record action and preserves the original failure. Until it does, the guarantee is entry into cleanup, not completion of cleanup.
what_would_confirm: A :record method that transfers control, leaving a later required record action unperformed.
consequence_if_confirmed: An act could be partially recorded. The remedy is a nested per-record UNWIND-PROTECT aggregating failures and re-signalling the original condition, discharged as PO-048 and verified by macroexpansion in a pinned SBCL.
